jobs_results.title: INGENIERO/A CIVIL - ARQUITECTO/A (Madrid)
jobs_results.description:
Únete al equipo de CADE y sé parte fundamental del desarrollo y despliegue de soluciones tecnológicas e innovadoras, para liderar la transición hacia una industria descarbonizada, digital y sostenible.

Formarás parte de un equipo altamente especializado, creativo e innovador, comprometido y en continua búsqueda de la excelencia, desarrollando proyectos y soluciones para importantes clientes industriales a nivel nacional e internacional.

Dispondrás de un plan de carrera y desarrollo profesional, orientado a potenciar tus habilidades y conocimientos mediante planes específicos de formación y seguimiento, orientados a cumplir tus aspiraciones profesionales maximizando tu valor a la empresa y al resto del equipo.

Ubicación

Oficina de Madrid.

¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades?

Ingeniería de la Propiedad y Supervisión de la fase de Operación y Mantenimiento de un proyecto singular ubicado en el centro de Madrid, consistente en sistemas mecánicos automatizados con sus respectivos... sistemas eléctricos de potencia y de control (PLC’s, DCS, BMS), grandes estructuras metálicas y de hormigón, así como de diversas instalaciones MEP/TEC (PCI, HVAC, eléctricas, calefacción, comunicaciones, sistemas agronómicos, montacargas y escaleras mecánicas, control de accesos, CCTV…).

Estamos buscando un Ingeniero/a Civil o Arquitecto/a, cuya misión del puesto consistirá en el diseño, planificación , control y mantenimiento de obras y proyectos de las infraestructuras.
• Monitorización del movimiento y deformación de las estructuras metálicas y de hormigón.
• Supervisión del mantenimiento de las estructuras metálicas durante la fase de operación y mantenimiento.
• Calculo, revisión y diseño en cimentaciones y estructuras.
• Revisión/actualización y generación de especificaciones técnicas.
• Revisión de planos y documentación técnica.
• Cálculo, diseño y mediciones en estimaciones.
• Dirección técnica de obra civil.

¿Qué esperamos de ti?
• Estudios Mínimos: Ingeniería Civil, Arquitectura.
• Experiencia mínima de 6 años en puesto similar.
• Manejo de herramientas BIM (ReCap, Trimble, etc.).
• Dominio de software de cálculo de estructuras metálicas y de hormigón (Staad Pro, Staad Fundation, Cype Ingenieros, etc.).
• Conocimiento de normativas aplicadas.
• Dominio de Microsoft Office.
• Manejo de herramientas para planificación y control de obra (Primavera, Project, Arquímedes, etc.).
• Disponibilidad de incorporación inmediata.

¿Qué ofrecemos?
• Proyecto atractivo y de gran envergadura en el que podrás participar y consolidar tu experiencia profesional.
• Salario acorde a la experiencia y los conocimientos.
• Plan de Carrera Profesional, con oportunidades de crecimiento profesional y desarrollo dentro de la organización.

Nuestro ADN. Nuestro equipo

Nos impulsa a dar siempre lo mejor de nosotros. Somos un equipo dedicado a la innovación en cada gestión y proceso, con un fuerte compromiso y enfoque centrado en el cliente. Trabajamos juntos para alcanzar la excelencia en cada proyecto.

En CADE, nuestro valor fundamental radica en las personas que integran nuestro equipo. Contamos con un grupo de profesionales con quienes podrás colaborar en proyectos técnicos altamente desafiantes, fomentando el trabajo en equipo.

Ofrecemos oportunidades para desarrollar tu trayectoria profesional dentro de la empresa, brindando formación y crecimiento en un ambiente laboral propicio, con flexibilidad para alcanzar un óptimo desempeño personal y profesional.

¡Te invitamos a unirte al equipo de CADE y ser parte de este emocionante camino hacia el éxito!

Somos un equipo que considera la diversidad como un valor fundamental y como origen de talento, por lo que trabajamos en nuestro día a día para promocionar un ambiente inclusivo y trabajar en el respeto, trabajo en equipo y compromiso con el fin de que todas las personas participen en igualdad de oportunidades en todos los procesos de la compañía. Invitamos a todas las personas a inscribirse con independencia del origen, circunstancias, bagaje o condición

jobs_results.title: Solutions Architect (Spanish-speaking)
jobs_results.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Stripe’s Solutions Architecture team works with our largest and most complex users to understand their business and technical requirements and map those to Stripe technology. We design robust technical solutions and seamlessly embed those into our users’ financial infrastructures to help them facilitate payment transactions, manage money movements and simplify operational processes.

What you’ll do

The Solutions Architect will build highly... consultative relationships with the decision makers in the user’s organisations to provide business and technical thought leadership, and become a trusted advisor in solving complex business challenges and driving growth for our users.
• Drive thought leadership and build executive relationships with key technical stakeholders including CEO, CTO, Head of Payments, etc.
• Be a domain expert in Stripe core technology and product suites
• Work to deeply understand the user’s business objectives and co-develop a financial services roadmap and reference architecture
• Expand Stripe’s footprint within existing users to new global markets by introducing new capabilities
• Collaborate with multiple internal stakeholders including Go-To-Market, Product & Engineer, Marketing, Legal, Risk and etc, to drive technical wins for our users
• Act as the voice of the customer to influence Stripe’s product roadmap on insights, trends, and opportunities across our users
• Work closely with professional services and partners to accelerate activations and time to live

Who you are

Solutions Architects are experienced technologists with a strong background developing integrations, consulting with customers to understand their objectives, and leveraging technology to drive business value.
• A capable engineer, with previous background building web or mobile applications and experience of working with customers and/or partners in a customer facing solution development role
• Possess strong technical knowledge in software architecture, have breadth across technology stacks with deep hands on skills, and comfortable talking about technical concepts and explaining how they work, both from a product feature and API architecture perspective
• A great communicator, comfortable explaining complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Interested in solving open ended business problems with a combination of technology and creative thinking.
• Experienced working in the sales lifecycle and driving outcomes in a customer-facing environment.

Minimum Requirements
• Is comfortable writing code in a few of Stripe’s primary deployment languages (Ruby, Python, JavaScript, Java, etc.) and enjoys learning new languages and technologies.
• Has experience integrating Stripe or other RESTful APIs into web applications.
• Has a background working in a similar customer-facing role (e.g. solutions architect, sales engineer, or partner engineer).
• 6+ years of experience.
• Thrives in a cross-functional, collaborative environment.
• Strong communication skills in both Spanish and English.

Preferred Qualifications
• Additional language: French or Italian
• A background in payments systems and ecommerce solutions

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (typically, 35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

A remote location, in most cases, is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is €92,200 - €138,400. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends

jobs_results.title: Solution Architect
jobs_results.description:
Role Overview
• Blue Yonder is seeking creative, high-energy talent who has both technical hands-on capabilities, as well as, domain knowledge in Supply Chain
• The candidate will be a part of the Manufacturing Industries organization and work closely in conjunction with Product Mgmt/Product Dev, Industry Solutions, Pre-Sales, Customer Implementation SA’s, as well as, Product Marketing
• The candidate will be self-driven, strong problem-solver with good communication skills, attention to details, competitive drive, good teamwork skills, and ability to synthesize perspectives at Industry levels to formulate and support industry messaging.
• The candidate is to have solution execution capability to accelerate product capabilities applied to the field (pre-sales, implementations). The candidate will be involved in positioning of solutions and developing demos in support of sales cycles, delivering impact to customers through solution architecting, and driving requirements back to the... product teams to improve competitiveness of Blue Yonder solutions.
• The candidate will be involved in various aspects of prospect to customer full lifecycle, including participating in Supply Chain Opportunity Assessment or Impact Assessment

Ideal Candidate Skills/Qualities
• This is position that requires knowledge of SCM domain, technical solution architecture, strong communication skills, tactical execution and the ability to identify and drive changes to the product with velocity.
• Excellent communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate with customers, succinctly articulate business impacts, translate technical information into layperson and business terms, concisely ‘storyboard’ complex problems, solutions, and approaches in a manner appropriate for executives, develop frameworks, templates, and high-quality pragmatic deliverables that can be carried forth and executed by project teams, and articulate and demonstrate gaps in our products based on real world customer use cases.
• He or she has problem solving skills with the ability to develop and analyze options/hypotheses objectively, applies industry-leading practices, and facilitates negotiations/discussions involving groups of diverse stakeholders.

Experience That Will Make This Role Successful
• In-depth understanding of and experience working within the key industry vertical and SCM industry solution architecture
• Extremely knowledgeable in Business, Industry, and IT Strategy and Architecture
• Partner or senior level engagement manager at a large systems integrator, IT Consulting firm or competitive organization where he/she has run a large solutions/services business; most likely at a level where they have managed the strategy and business development efforts
• In-depth understanding of current cloud technologies and products, and has a strong sense for market trends and emerging technologies and tools within and outside Supply Chain solutions
• Professional leadership of global customer engagements, including an understanding of customers unique business needs and objectives and budget situation (Total cost of operation)
• Has built transformation enterprise architecture in Large or Complex organizations that align with their business strategy and goals driving growth and cost reduction.

Desired Skills
• Solution Architecture for Software as a Service (SaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS) and technologies including databases, analytical solutions, IoT, and its applications
• Intrapreneurship & new solution introduction
• Presales skills such as discovery sessions, requirement gathering, solution architecture, presentation to the C-suite, BY solution demonstrations on industry scenarios
• Design Thinking methodology for product innovation and design led digital transformation.

Our Values

If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values

Diversity, Inclusion, Value & Equality (DIVE) is our strategy for fostering an inclusive environment we can be proud of. Check out Blue Yonder's inaugural Diversity Report which outlines our commitment to change, and our video celebrating the differences in all of us in the words of some of our associates from around the world.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status

jobs_results.title: BSS Solution Architect
jobs_results.description:
¡Hola! Somos CAPGEMINI

Tenemos la gran suerte de trabajar en un sector que lidera la evolución hacia un futuro sostenible e inclusivo. La TECNOLOGÍA. El catalizador de tantas soluciones que necesitamos ahora más que nunca.

Somos 360.000 PERSONAS en todo el mundo unidas por una misma pasión. No importa dónde estemos, podemos estar en casa, en la oficina, a mil kilómetros de distancia unxs de otrxs, pero somos conscientes de que NUESTRO TRABAJO CUENTA. No importa en qué momento vital estemos, somos DIVERSOS en edad, género, ascendencia, familia… ¡nos hemos certificado en Diversidad y como empresa ÉTICA más de 9 años seguidos! Si aprecias la FLEXIBILIDAD, la CONCILIACION y los BENEFICIOS fiscales y sociales para compaginar tu vida personal y profesional, ¡esta es tu compañía!

Lo que importa es que puedes sentir que estás DONDE DEBES ESTAR para conseguir el futuro que deseas

¿Qué buscamos? Profesionales con experiencia como BSS Solution Architect que quieran formar parte de nuestra... unidad de Cloud & Custom Applications, donde compartirás conocimientos con más de 1.700 personas que te ayudaran a afrontar nuevos retos con las tecnologías más punteras del mercado. ¿Tienes curiosidad por conocer a algunos de nuestros mejores profesionales? ¿Deseas conocer a nuestros expertos H.K y R.P? No dudes en INSCRIBIRTE, ellos están deseando conocerte.

Cada proyecto CUENTA. ¿Te apetece sumarte? ¿Qué harás en el proyecto? ¿Cuál será tu rol?

Buscamos un Arquitecto de soluciones BSS para trabajar con un cliente internacional del sector telecomunicaciones.

Sería interesante contar con alguno de estos conocimientos previos:
• Amplia experiencia trabajando como arquitecto de soluciones dentro de Consultoría especializada en estándares de la industria de telecomunicaciones
• Sólida experiencia en desarrollo de software, gestión de proyectos técnicos, entrega digital o consultoría tecnológica
• Experiencia en clientes Telco con conocimiento empresarial de BSS
• Inglés fluido

Valoraremos todas las candidaturas. En Capgemini contamos con una amplísima oferta formativa, presencial, online de Certificaciones, etc. Aunque no tengas el 100% de los conocimientos valorados ¡nos encantará conocerte!

La colaboración es clave en el desarrollo de nuevas ideas, de nuevas soluciones, del crecimiento profesional y personal y por eso para nosotrxs es vital el equipo y el buen clima. Trabajamos y potenciamos nuestras COMUNIDADES dentro de la compañía.

Tenemos un CATALOGO DE MEDIDAS de desarrollo y conciliación muy completo (ayudas familiares, seguros y tickets, días festivos adicionales de tiempo para ti y lxs tuyxs, etc…) ¿Nos vemos y te lo contamos?

Hoy has conocido algo más sobre nosotrxs y nuestro proyecto en crecimiento. Mañana saldrán otros proyectos porque así trabajamos, generando soluciones a medida que se nos necesita ¿Te unes al equipo hoy

jobs_results.title: Solution Architect
jobs_results.description:
The future is our choice

At Atos, as the global leader in secure and decarbonized digital, our purpose is to help design the future of the information space. Together we bring the diversity of our people’s skills and backgrounds to make the right choices with our clients, for our company and for our own futures.

We are looking for a Solution Architect to solution design Infrastructure deals and join our diverse Atos team. He/She is customer oriented and works closely with customers to ensure a clear understanding of their business priorities and needs and designs competitive and sustainable end-to-end solutions based on our portfolio and partners.

Role Description And Responsibilities
• Identifies and requests the necessary contributors (solution architect or subject matter expert, T&T manager, or Partner) to build the solution.
• Manages the solution design following the winning strategy agreed. Creates the Solution Storyboard.
• Document and review assumptions and risk log... including suitable risk mitigation.
• Consolidates cost model in the official pricing tools and work closely with financial architect to create the mapping between cost and price unit.
• Manages the proposal development processes, ensuring that the storyline is properly transcribed in a compelling way, writes missing parts in the documents that make up the proposal, and includes value added thinking on customer benefits.
• Understands and follows the bidding and delivery approval processes during bid phase.
• Presents the solution designed and the business case in a compelling and concise manner at Senior levels, seeking for the required approvals.
• Explains and defends the solution story to customer a with a solid view on our value proposition, pushing the benefits for customer.
• Creates exceptional customer-facing document, presentations, and proposals.
• Successfully executes a controlled bid closure and participates in the handover to the delivery team.

Technical Skills
• AWS and/or Azure. Terraform, Docker, Git (certifications preferred).
• Hybrid Cloud and IT Infrastructure
• Automation & Orchestration (Jenkins, Puppet, Ansible)
• Middleware management database, web services, ssl certificates
• Virtualization VMs, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Hyper V
• Data Center LAN
• WAN - SDWAN
• Network access VPN, IPsec
• Network security
• Experience in working in an agile environment and able to integrate architecture practices in an agile WoW.

Language Skills
• Spanish Native
• English Minimum B2
• Catalan Native, is a plus.

Experience Required
• At least 10 years in Information Technology Managed Services and Solutions.
• At least 5 years in Presales as lead Solution Manager in an international environment

jobs_results.title: ERP Solutions Architect
jobs_results.description:
We are Bring IT!

We are a fast growing and dynamic professional services firm dedicated to driving digital transformation for clients worldwide. Our efforts span from product launches to enhancing efficiency through technology and processes, ultimately revolutionizing work methods.

Job Description

Responsible for tackling the challenges that come with implementing, optimizing, and maintaining cloud investments. We help organizations get the most out of technology investments, including New System and Module Implementations, System Integrations, Upgrade Assessments, Application Upgrades, and Business Process Optimization.

Your Impact
• Lead NetSuite projects: new implementations, enhancements, integrations, and support.
• Innovate for improved methodologies and solutions.
• Cultivate client relationships, identifying new business opportunities.
• Present technical concepts and project details to stakeholders.
• Support revenue recognition solutions and share NetSuite best... practices.
• Collaborate with development for customer solutions and clarify proposals.
• Draft architecture documents aligned with business needs and system landscape.
• Drive end-to-end NetSuite solutions and coordinate across teams.
• Shape solution design through active participation in client meetings.

Requirements for the position:
• Experience: 5+ years in full NetSuite lifecycle: implementation, upgrade, and support.
• Design and Configuration: Proficiency in designing and configuring NetSuite.
• Technical Skills: Knowledge of Suite Script, Suite Flow, Integrations, and Reporting.
• Customization: Expertise in data conversions, interfaces/integrations, reporting, and customizations.
• Analytical Skills: Ability to identify functional and technical gaps.
• Training and Support: Training end users and providing support.
• Flexibility: Up to 25% travel flexibility.
• Education: bachelor’s degree in finance or related.
• Certifications: NetSuite Suite Foundation, Certified ERP Consultant, Multi-book, Advanced Revenue Management, or OpenAir Certifications.
• Background: Accounting, finance, or operations experience

jobs_results.description: Join a Thriving Financial Services Team in Sunny Valencia! Looking for an exciting career move in the heart of Valencia, Spain? Here's your chance! Our client, renowned for tailored financial services in private equity and fund investment, seeks a visionary Automation Solutions Architect to join their dynamic team permanently. Why You? You'll spearhead our automation revolution, driving the analysis, design, and deployment of cutting-edge BPM/RPA solutions. If you're a seasoned MS Power Platform Developer with over 3 years of hands-on automation expertise, this role was made for you! Responsibilities: Lead custom MS Power Platform solutions from conception to execution. Build strong relationships with key stakeholders to identify pain points and align automation solutions with business objectives. Develop and deploy innovative automation solutions that transform operations. Showcase tailored technology demos to our executive team and users. Prepare compelling demonstrations and... user-friendly training materials to showcase and facilitate adoption of automation tools. Advise on best practices, governance, and standards for Power Platform. Collaborate with external experts to drive project success. Analyze business processes, recommend enhancements, and implement streamlined automation solutions to optimize efficiency. Requirements: 3+ years of project management or system design experience. Proven track record in automation with MS Power Platform. Proficiency in Canvas and Model-Driven Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Power Virtual Agents, Dataverse, AI Builder. Strong database skills (SQL Server, Azure Gateway) and familiarity with Microsoft 365. Conditions: Hybrid working model in vibrant Valencia. Competitive salary: €30k - €45k / year.
